items.originalTitle: Franco Colapinto responds to Jeremy Clarkson’s controversial comment about him
items.summaryEn: Franco Colapinto has responded to Jeremy Clarkson's comment that he would give the Alpine Formula 1 driver a grid penalty for being Argentinian. Clarkson joked during a Sky Sports F1 interview at the United States Grand Prix: "Franco's got a grid penalty for being Argentinian. Probably. Well, I'd give him one for that. But anyway, that's just because of what happened when we went there."
detailZh: 弗兰科·科拉平托回应了杰里米·克拉克森关于因他是阿根廷人而应给他罚退的言论。
克拉克森开玩笑说，科拉平托因为他是阿根廷人而应该被罚退。
弗兰科·科拉平托回应了杰里米·克拉克森关于因他是阿根廷人而应给这位阿尔派一级方程式车手罚退的言论。
克拉克森是作为阿尔派车队的嘉宾出席美国大奖赛的，并于周六接受了天空体育F1的采访，他在采访中开玩笑说：“弗兰科因为他是阿根廷人而得到了罚退。大概吧。好吧，我会因此给他一个罚退。但不管怎样，那只是因为我们去那里时发生的事情。”
克拉克森指的是科拉平托因超出动力单元部件配额而实际受到的罚退，而且很可能还指他主持的《Top Gear》节目2014年的巴塔哥尼亚特辑。当时，因为一块引发争议的车牌，阿根廷抗议者将其解读为对马岛战争的影射，导致拍摄提前中断，双方关系一度紧张。
阿尔派随后就克拉克森的言论发表声明：“阿尔派方面已知悉一名车队客人在奥斯汀近期电视采访中发表的评论。弗朗哥是我们的车手，我们全力支持他。”
二十四小时后，赛后媒体采访区有人向科拉平托本人提起了这件事。
“当然，这和车队没有任何关系，”他说。“他是自己接受采访的，与车队无关。我觉得他一直都只是在开玩笑，我并不真正认识他，但他们是这么告诉我的。”
“他说的话我没怎么看，但我听说杰米（Jamie Campbell-Walter，科拉平托的经纪人）在社交媒体上发了些东西。
“我想，还是尽量专注于我们自己吧。我当然会努力改善现状，但这在某种程度上需要很多人的帮助，而不仅仅是我自己。我们看看最终会怎样，但嗯，我想情况不算最好。”
林德布拉德碰撞导致侧箱和底板受损
弗兰科·科拉平托，阿尔派车队，阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛车队
科拉平托在奥斯汀的比赛中，于第25圈1号弯与阿尔维德·林德布拉德发生碰撞，比赛因此提前结束，当时小红牛赛车从外侧试图争夺第14位。林德布拉德的左侧箱和科拉平托的右前角相触，导致阿尔派赛车打转，随后退赛。
“皮埃尔（加斯利）刚从维修区出来，我试图把阿尔维德挡在身后，这样皮埃尔就能保持在前面，”科拉平托回忆道。“我们三辆车并排，我被夹在中间，所以赛车完全损坏了。但这就是比赛的一部分。
“整个侧箱和底板都坏了。真遗憾。
“我从后面起步，然后从一开始就真的不顺利。我选择用硬胎，看看能不能做出一些有趣的事情，但我们没能做到。”
“我期待墨西哥站，扭转局面，不再受罚，回到完赛的节奏。”
科拉平托在最近四场大奖赛中退赛三场，他在巴库引发连环撞车，在新加坡遭遇疑似传动系统故障。这与他F1生涯其余比赛的退赛次数一样多。
这位阿尔派车手确实称自己周末的正赛速度“非常强”，因此希望在即将到来的墨西哥和巴西拉丁美洲赛事中取得不错的成绩。
detailEn: Franco Colapinto responds to Jeremy Clarkson’s controversial comment about him
Clarkson joked that Colapinto deserved a grid penalty for being Argentinian
Franco Colapinto has responded to Jeremy Clarkson’s comment that he would give the Alpine Formula 1 driver a grid penalty for being Argentinian.

Clarkson was a guest of Alpine’s at the United States Grand Prix and gave an interview to Sky Sports F1 on Saturday, in which he joked: “Franco’s got a grid penalty for being Argentinian. Probably. Well, I’d give him one for that. But anyway, that’s just because of what happened when we went there.”

Clarkson was referring to Colapinto’s actual grid penalty for exceeding his power unit parts quota and, most likely, to his Top Gear show’s 2014 Patagonia special. At the time, tensions emerged due to a contentious license plate that Argentinian protesters interpreted as a reference to the Falklands War, cutting the filming short.

Alpine soon issued a statement in response to Clarkson’s comment: “We at Alpine are aware of the comments made by a team guest in a recent television interview in Austin. Franco is our driver and has our full support.”
Twenty-four hours later, the issue was brought up to Colapinto himself in the post-race media pen.

“Of course, it's nothing to do with the team,” he said. “He did an interview on his own, it's nothing related to the team. I think he's always been kind of joking, I don't really know him, but they told me.
“I didn't see too much of what he said, but I heard that Jamie [Campbell-Walter, Colapinto’s manager] put something on social media.

“I guess, just try to focus on ourselves. I try to improve the situation of course, it kind of needs help from a lot of people, not just from me. We'll see how we end up, but yeah, not the best, I guess.”
Sideboard and floor broken by Lindblad collision
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls

Colapinto’s Austin race was curtailed by a collision with Arvid Lindblad in Turn 1 on lap 25, with the Racing Bulls going around the outside for 14th position. Lindblad’s left-hand sidepod and Colapinto’s front-right corner touched, sending the Alpine into a spin – and, later on, into retirement.

“Pierre [Gasly] was out of the pits, I was trying to keep Arvid behind, so Pierre could be ahead,” Colapinto recounted. “We were the three of us side by side and I got sandwiched, so I got totally damaged. But it's part of racing.
“The whole sideboard and floor was broken. A pity.
“I started from the back and then it really didn't work from the start. I chose to do it on the hard to see if we could do something interesting, but we couldn't.
“I'm looking forward to Mexico, to turn this around and not do the penalties and go back to finishing races.”

Colapinto has retired from three of the last four grands prix, having caused the Baku pile-up and suffered a suspected driveline issue in Singapore. That was as many retirements as in the rest of his F1 career.
The Alpine driver did describe his race pace as “very strong” over the weekend and is therefore hoping for decent results in the upcoming Latin American races in Mexico and Brazil.

detailZh: 胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚质疑乔治·罗素在美国大奖赛的5秒处罚
前一级方程式车手胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚对美国大奖赛中乔治·罗素的5秒处罚表示"惊讶"，声称梅赛德斯车手并未从该事件中获得优势
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括一级方程式新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯
前一级方程式车手胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚对美国大奖赛中乔治·罗素的处罚表示惊讶，声称梅赛德斯车手并未从该事件中获得优势
拉塞尔因为在美洲赛车场的第12弯道离开赛道并在第一圈重新加入时超过了麦凯轮车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，被处以五秒罚时。他最终完成了第八名，而他的梅赛德斯车队队友基米·安东内利赢得了比赛。
在奥斯汀的F1电视赛后节目中，蒙托亚辩称，拉塞尔的举动并没有带来优势。
“我对乔治的罚时感到惊讶，因为他实际上并没有获得优势，”蒙托亚解释道。"如果他获得了优势，他应该会在哈吉亚旁边。
“他旁边不会有一辆麦凯轮。所以我对此有点惊讶。但你要把它留给国际汽联。他们有自己的观点。”
进入下一轮比赛，拉塞尔在车手积分榜上排名第二，但受到仅落后他一分的三位车手莱维斯·汉密尔顿、马克斯·维斯塔潘和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的威胁。
乔治·拉塞尔为什么在2026年美国大奖赛中受到处罚？
裁判组对拉塞尔处以五秒罚时，原因是他在赛道外行驶并"获得持久优势"。
国际汽联的官方声明中提到，裁判组审查了位置/指挥系统数据、视频和车内视频证据，以及通过国际汽联证据通道从车队63和81收到的提交材料。
“车号63的车手在12号弯道中防守车号81的位置，然后离开了赛道，随后在13号弯道前重新加入赛道，并保持了这一位置。据此，裁判员判定他离开了赛道，重新加入并获得了持续的竞争优势。”
“对此事件的正常处罚是10秒罚时，然而裁判员认为车号63的车手之前一直在给车号6施加压力，这使得车号81处于进攻位置（因此车号63处于防守位置）。此外，这是一次第一圈事件，在我们的判断中，罚时应减轻至5秒。”
detailEn: Juan Pablo Montoya questions George Russell's F1 United States GP penalty
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has questioned George Russell's five-second penalty at the United States Grand Prix
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya was "surprised" by George Russell's penalty at the United States Grand Prix, claiming the Mercedes driver did not gain an advantage from the incident.

Russell was handed a five-second penalty for leaving the track at Turn 12 and rejoining ahead of McLaren's Oscar Piastri on the opening lap at the Circuit of the Americas. He went on to finish eighth, while his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli won the race.
Speaking on F1 TV's post-race show in Austin, Montoya argued that Russell's move did not result in an advantage.
"I’m surprised about the penalty for George, because he didn’t really gain an advantage," Montoya explained. "If he had gained an advantage, he would have been next to Hadjar.
"He wouldn’t have had a McLaren next to him. So I was kind of surprised with that. But you’ve got to leave it to the FIA. They have their point of view."

Heading into the next round, Russell sits second in the championship but is under threat from Lewis Hamilton, who is just one point behind him in third, Max Verstappen in fourth and Charles Leclerc in fifth.
Why was George Russell penalised during the 2026 United States Grand Prix?
The stewards handed Russell a five-second penalty for leaving the track and "gaining a lasting advantage".

"The stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence, plus submissions from the teams of Cars 63 and 81 via the FIA Evidence Channel," the official statement from the FIA read.

"The driver of Car 63 was defending position from Car 81, into Turn 12 and left the track, then proceeded to rejoin in front of Car 81, prior to Turn 13. He retained that position. Accordingly, he is determined by the stewards to have left the track, rejoined it and gained a lasting advantage.

"The normal penalty for this is a 10-second penalty, however the stewards considered that the driver of Car 63 had previously been pressuring Car 6 and that put Car 81 into an attacking position (and therefore Car 63 into a defending position). Further, this was a first-lap incident and in our determination, the penalty should be mitigated to 5 seconds."

拉塞尔因在第一圈12号弯道出赛道并重新加入赛道而受到5秒处罚
keyPointsEn: Juan Pablo Montoya expressed surprise at George Russell's penalty
George Russell was penalized with a five-second penalty for leaving the track at Turn 12

items.originalTitle: What time is F1's 2026 Mexican Grand Prix? Full weekend schedule
detailZh: 2026年的F1®墨西哥城大奖赛极有可能迎来首次新王加冕——对于这样一个场合来说，这是一场备受喜爱且充满活力的赛事。
基米·安东内利只需要两分——相当于第九名的成绩——就能在20岁时成为F1冠军。乔治·罗素和刘易斯·汉密尔顿未能赢得比赛也将对安东内利有利。
尽管此时冠军争夺战几乎已经变成了一种仪式，但仍有充分的理由期待在赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上会有一场精彩的比赛——由于这是F1中海拔最高的赛道，它总是以独特的方式考验车辆，并对竞争秩序造成破坏。
以下是你周末所有重要的练习时间，以及如何在Apple TV上观看比赛的详细信息。
观看2026年墨西哥城大奖赛™，时间：10月30日至11月1日，仅在Apple TV上播出。美国地区专播。
从2026年开始，Apple TV将成为美国F1的新家。
粉丝可以通过注册Apple TV并访问苹果的新专属F1频道，实时观看墨西哥大奖赛周末的每一分钟。
苹果公司将提供2026年F1的所有练习、资格赛和比赛的现场直播，以及完整的回放和精彩集锦库，以防您错过任何现场直播的比赛。
除了赛前和赛后节目，还有额外的现场直播来跟踪比赛，包括22个车手车内摄像头、实时计时、车手追踪器等。

detailEn: The Formula 1® Gran Premio De La Ciudad De Mexico is overwhelmingly likely to play host to a first-time coronation in 2026 - and is a fittingly beloved and exuberant event for such an occasion.

Kimi Antonelli needs just two points - the equivalent of a ninth-place finish - to become F1 champion aged 20. George Russell and Lewis Hamilton failing to win the race would also do the trick for Antonelli.

But even if the title race is almost ceremonial at this point, there's every reason to expect a good race from the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez - which always taxes cars in unusual ways and wreaks havoc with the competitive order, due to being F1's highest-altitude race by a massive margin.
Below you'll find the all-important session times for the weekend, as well as all the information on where to watch the action on Apple TV.
Watch The Formula 1 Gran Premio De La Ciudad De Mexico 2026™ on Apple TV, October 30-November 1. U.S. only.
Apple TV is the new home of F1 in the US from 2026.
Fans can view every minute of the Mexican Grand Prix weekend live by signing up to Apple TV and accessing Apple's new dedicated F1 channel.
Apple has every F1 2026 practice, qualifying and race live, as well as a full catch-up and highlights catalogue in case you miss any of the action live.
As well as pre and post-race programming, there are additional live feeds to follow the action, including 22 onboard driver cameras, live timing, driver trackers and more.
